meta.title: Aymen Smida — Senior Full Stack Developer (Laravel)
meta.description: Aymen Smida is a senior full stack developer with 7+ years of experience building high-performance web applications with PHP, Laravel, Livewire, Vue.js and MySQL.

hero.titleLead: I build web applications that stay
hero.intro: I'm Aymen Smida, a senior full stack developer with over 7 years of experience in the PHP/Laravel ecosystem. I build high-performance applications, design clean REST APIs, and craft interfaces that stay fast under real-world load.

about.title: Engineering that balances performance, clarity and maintainability.
about.p1: I'm a senior full stack developer specializing in the PHP/Laravel ecosystem. Over the past 7+ years I've worked across agencies, freelance engagements and international remote teams, delivering web applications that have to stay fast and reliable in production.
about.p2: My work sits between backend architecture and interface craft: designing relational data models, building secure RESTful APIs, and wiring reactive frontends with Livewire and Vue.js. I profile before optimizing — Redis caching, queue-driven workloads, and SQL that stays predictable as data grows.
about.p3: I've collaborated with clients and cross-functional teams across Saudi Arabia and Tunisia, and I'm comfortable owning a feature from technical analysis through testing, deployment and iteration.
about.philosophy: Measure first, optimize second. Keep the data model honest, the API predictable, and the interface fast enough that nobody has to think about it.
do: Backend architecture with Laravel and PHP 8
RESTful API design and third-party integrations
Performance tuning: Redis, queues and SQL optimization
Component-driven interfaces with Livewire and Vue.js

skills.title: Skills & technologies
skills.intro: The stack I use to design, build and ship production web applications.

experience.title: Professional experience
experience.intro: Seven years of building and maintaining web products, from legacy replacements to remote platform work.

bullets: Architected dynamic, interactive web applications with Laravel 10/11 and Livewire.
Implemented Redis for caching and asynchronous job queues, significantly improving server execution speed.
Designed responsive interfaces handling bulk CSV uploads and real-time data charts with Highcharts.
Built and consumed secure RESTful APIs to integrate third-party services.
Enforced PHPUnit testing procedures to keep production environments stable.
Analysed technical requirements and worked directly with clients to deliver custom software.
Built full-stack applications with a PHP/Laravel backend and reactive Vue.js interfaces.
Integrated external APIs including Telegram Bot API, Google Maps API and payment gateways.
Refactored legacy codebases and optimized complex MySQL queries for faster execution.
Designed and deployed full-featured web applications in PHP and MySQL to replace complex legacy spreadsheet workflows.
Structured relational database schemas and optimized complex SQL queries for operational data.
Developed responsive dashboard interfaces and automated PDF/Excel export modules.
